description: This file handles copying and processing plugin metadata for a build system, including managing plugin directories, rewriting package extensions, copying skill assets with retries, and generating bundled plugin manifests.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites extensions entries to use '.js' extensions and adds './' prefix.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects and filters top-level public surface JavaScript/TypeScript files in a plugin directory.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and entries.

methods.name: rewritePackageEntry
methods.description: Rewrites a package entry string to replace its extension with '.js' and adds './' prefix.

methods.name: ensurePathInsideRoot
methods.description: Ensures a given path is within a specified root directory, resolving any escapes.

methods.name: normalizeManifestRelativePath
methods.description: Normalizes a manifest path to use '/' separators and removes leading './'.

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the source path of a skill specified in the manifest, considering plugin and repo roots.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target output path for a bundled skill, relocating node_modules assets under a specific directory.

methods.name: isTransientCopyError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a transient error during file copy operations.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous sleep for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: copySkillPathWithRetry
methods.description: Copies a skill path with retries for transient errors.

methods.name: copyDeclaredPluginSkillPaths
methods.description: Copies declared plugin skill paths to the distribution directory, handling nested node_modules exclusions.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main exported function that copies plugin metadata, handles directory processing, and updates manifests.
